purpose: exploratory feasibility of natural post-acquisition occlusion measurement by obstacle density; no confirmatory density inference
seed_role: exploratory feasibility only; reruns of existing A1/A3 seeds so G0 can compare the first four episodes per environment

g0_noninterference.rule: per cell, the first 4 episodes of every environment equal the historical cell: ledger fields exactly and every recorder field present in both
g0_noninterference.on_mismatch: stop the run at that cell, keep everything, report the differing fields; no identity claim
g0_noninterference.scope: telemetry on versus historical telemetry off, different source commits with identical simulation code paths; a mismatch alone does not say which difference caused it

renderer_parity.needs: R-P1a mesh probe ran (supported fixed-bar scene, analytic_flat render) and ZERO_LATENCY_RENDER_DELIVERY

analysis: tools/occlusion_analysis.py pilot; Kaplan-Meier with its independent-censoring caveat plus Aalen-Johansen cumulative incidence by end cause; rates per post-acquisition exposure second; episode-cluster bootstrap and per-seed values
geometry_only: tools/occlusion_analysis.py sweep over the pilot's recorded layouts, three scripted families (static_pursuit, static_crossing, moving_pursuit at 1.5 m/s), collisions ignored, labelled GEOMETRY_ONLY_KINEMATIC_BASELINE and reported apart from the whole-system pilot. Straight pursuit of a static target cannot re-occlude after a clear sight line, so static post-acquisition occlusion in the pilot can only come from detours or lateral motion
stop_rules: any integrity, contract, identity or trace failure
1.0 h cumulative wall time (running cell killed and kept)
